seo_title: PWA SEO Audit: Stop Indexation Loss from Service Workers
seo_desc: Discover how a misconfigured Service Worker serves an empty App Shell to Google. PWA technical SEO audit to recover your organic B2B traffic.
author_pitch: I've seen B2B giants vanish from Google overnight due to a technical 'upgrade'. I will teach you how to master modern crawling so technology drives your sales, rather than sinking them.
title: The PWA Mirage: How Your Service Worker is Serving an Empty Web to Google
body:
Is your recent PWA upgrade destroying your search rankings?

You invested thousands into converting your B2B platform into an ultra-fast Progressive Web App. Users are thrilled with the mobile speed, but your analytics show a grim picture: organic traffic is plummeting and your transactional keywords are disappearing. The culprit isn't the algorithm, but your own client-side code intercepting the crawl.

The trap of the local cache (App Shell)

To make your website incredibly fast, you implemented a Service Worker that stores the base structure (App Shell) in the browser. The problem is that the modern Googlebot renders JavaScript and executes Service Workers. If you don't filter its User-Agent, your PWA is serving it an empty "loading" page with no real content. Extreme speed for the user, absolute invisibility for Google..

Our solution: B2B Service Worker Audit

At LANZAESTUDIO, we implement a conditional crawling bypass strategy directly in your Service Worker's lifecycle, ensuring that Googlebot always receives the fully prerendered HTML (SSR) intact.

  1. Conditional Interception: We configure the sw.js file to detect Google IPs and crawling User-Agents, bypassing the client cache entirely.
  2. Stale-While-Revalidate Strategy: We adjust Workbox routing so human users maintain maximum speed without interfering with your Crawl Budget.
  3. App Shell Synchronization: We force the injection of critical SEO metadata into the base skeleton in case a temporary network failure occurs.
  4. Fetch API Monitoring: We audit the outgoing requests from the Service Worker to guarantee there are no hidden CORS blocks against Googlebot.

The Real Impact on your B2B Sales

  • Indexation Recovery: Get your product pages back into Google's index in less than 7 days.
  • Optimized Crawl Budget: Prevent Google from wasting resources downloading redundant caches from your PWA.
  • Return of Transactional Traffic: Reactivate the flow of qualified leads that had stalled after your last technical deployment.
